entries.question: What products do you sell?
entries.answer: Mumchies offers sweets, savouries, millet noodles and pasta, and gifting options. Browse the current range at https://mumchies.com/collections/all-products.
phrases: what products do you deal with

entries.question: Which sweets do you have?
entries.answer: Our range includes Dry Fruit Laddu, Jaggery Kaju Katli, Stuffed Choco Dates and other sweets. Please check https://mumchies.com/collections/all-products for current options.

entries.question: Does Dry Fruit Laddu have refined sugar?
entries.answer: Our Dry Fruit Laddu is listed as having no refined sugar. Please check the pack or product listing for the full ingredients and nutrition details.
phrases: does your dry fruit laddu have sugar

entries.question: Do your products contain added preservatives?
entries.answer: Mumchies states that its products are made without added preservatives. For a specific product, please check the pack ingredients.

entries.question: Do you use palm oil?
entries.answer: Mumchies states that it does not use palm oil in its products.

entries.question: Which oil do you use for savouries?
entries.answer: Our website says our namkeens use rice-bran oil. Ingredients may vary by product, so please check the specific pack.

entries.question: How should I store the products?
entries.answer: Store in a cool, dry place and keep the pack tightly sealed after opening. Follow the storage instructions printed on your pack.

entries.question: What is the shelf life?
entries.answer: Shelf life varies by product. Please use the best-before or expiry date printed on the specific pack; we can help with product-specific details.

entries.question: Do you deliver across India?
entries.answer: We ship to most locations in India. Delivery availability and timelines depend on your pincode and order.

entries.question: Is shipping free?
entries.answer: Our website currently advertises free shipping on orders over ₹399. Please confirm the applicable charges at checkout.

entries.question: Is there a prepaid discount?
entries.answer: Our website currently advertises an extra 5% discount on prepaid orders. The final offer and eligibility will be shown at checkout.

entries.question: How do I place an order?
entries.answer: You can explore products and place an order at https://mumchies.com. If you need help choosing products, tell us what you are looking for.

entries.question: Do you have millet noodles or pasta?
entries.answer: Yes, Mumchies offers millet noodles and pasta. You can browse the latest options at https://mumchies.com/collections/all-products.

entries.question: Do you offer corporate gifting?
entries.answer: Yes. Mumchies offers corporate and bulk gifting, with curated hampers and customisation options. Share your quantity, budget, destination and required date for a quote.
phrases: what is your moq for corporate gifting

entries.question: Can you add our company logo to gift hampers?
entries.answer: Corporate gifting options can include branded sleeves, boxes, stickers and gift cards, depending on the order. Our team can confirm feasibility and pricing.

entries.question: Can corporate gifts go to multiple addresses?
entries.answer: Yes, Mumchies supports office delivery and individual-address corporate gifting. Final serviceability, charges and timing depend on the destination list.

entries.question: Can we request corporate gifting samples?
entries.answer: Sampling may be available depending on the hamper and delivery location. Our gifting team can confirm sample options and charges.

entries.question: How can I contact Mumchies?
entries.answer: You can email wecare@mumchies.com or call +91 83103 37505, as listed on our website.

entries.question: Does this product contain allergens?
entries.answer: For allergy safety, please check the complete ingredient and allergen information on the specific pack. Tell us the product and allergen, and our team can help verify.

entries.question: What is the price?
entries.answer: Prices vary by product and offer. Please check the current price on https://mumchies.com/collections/all-products, or tell us which product interests you.
